# Monzo

English · [Русский](../ru/companies/monzo.md) · [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md) › [Companies](../README.md#companies)

Fintech and payments · International · Loop reviewed 2026-09-26

Monzo's 2025 engineering articles describe task or pair-coding routes and Staff+ leadership assessment; its product article dates to 2022. These are general-role baselines. All three sources are employer publications, without independent corroboration; confirm the current format.

On this page: [Interview loop](#loop) · [Official preparation material](#prep) · [Questions (2)](#questions)

## Roles covered

- **AI Engineering:** Software engineer (general interview baseline)
- **AI Leadership:** Product manager (general interview baseline)

## <a id="loop"></a>Interview loop

| Stage | What happens | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Engineering initial call | An hour on background, recent projects, technical challenges and trade-offs. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Demystifying the Backend Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-03-01, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Take-home or pair coding | Either a small program written in your own time and then reviewed, or about an hour of pairing with an engineer to implement a provided interface. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Demystifying the Backend Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-03-01, retrieved 2026-09-26<br>[Demystifying the Senior Staff+ Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-senior-staff-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-05-02, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Systems design | A collaborative whiteboard session on scalable, reliable and fault-tolerant systems; Staff+ candidates go deeper into scalability, testing and security. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Demystifying the Backend Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-03-01, retrieved 2026-09-26<br>[Demystifying the Senior Staff+ Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-senior-staff-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-05-02, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Behavioural | An hour with two interviewers on communication, learning, teamwork and delivering projects. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Demystifying the Backend Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-03-01, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Impact and leadership (Staff+) | How you spot opportunities as a leader and convince a group of people to act on them. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Demystifying the Senior Staff+ Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-senior-staff-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-05-02, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Product manager loop (2022) | A 30-minute recruiter screen, a 45-minute chat about product experience, then a 20-minute walkthrough of your most impactful product, an interactive case study and a leadership interview. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Product Management at Monzo: The interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/2022/10/04/product-management-at-monzo-the-interview-process), Monzo, published 2022-10-04, retrieved 2026-09-26 |

**Coding:** varies by role. The 2025 engineering description includes coding; the 2022 product description lists no coding stage. Confirm the current role-specific process. ([Demystifying the Backend Engineering interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process), Monzo, published 2025-03-01, retrieved 2026-09-26, [Product Management at Monzo: The interview process](https://monzo.com/blog/2022/10/04/product-management-at-monzo-the-interview-process), Monzo, published 2022-10-04, retrieved 2026-09-26)

## <a id="questions"></a>Questions reported for Monzo

### [AI product strategy and metrics](../themes/ai-product-strategy.md)

- **[Walk through the product you built that had the greatest impact, including the business case and evidence of results.](../themes/ai-product-strategy.md#prod-impactful-product)**
  - Self-presentation · Senior · Asked at: Monzo ✅
  - Tests: Whether you can connect personal decisions, experiments and realised impact.

### [Leading engineering teams](../themes/engineering-leadership.md)

- **[Describe how you identified a valuable opportunity and persuaded a group to deliver it.](../themes/engineering-leadership.md#lead-opportunity-coalition)**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: Monzo ✅ · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#lead-opportunity-coalition)
  - Tests: Whether you create influence through evidence, alignment and shared ownership.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Explain why the opportunity mattered and how you discovered it.
    - Describe competing priorities, objections and how participants shaped the plan.
    - Show delivery and impact, including what remained outside your control.
  - Read: [Design Docs at Google](https://www.industrialempathy.com/posts/design-docs-at-google/) (Industrial Empathy) · [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)
